headline: Every time our company evolves, he's the person we trust to rebuild the story.
quote: Ben's superpower is helping companies figure out who they are and then putting that message into the right format to communicate it. We've hired him twice now, once in 2020 and again in 2026, because every time our company evolves, he's the person we trust to rebuild the story. What makes him unique is his ability to create copy and design together, in context. He doesn't hand anything off to a designer. He develops both in parallel, and that's harder to find than most people realize.
name: Chris Scott
